esqlQuery.esql:
FROM metrics-logstash.pipeline-*
| WHERE logstash.pipeline.total.queues.type == "persisted"
| EVAL pipeline = logstash.pipeline.name, host = logstash.pipeline.host.name
| STATS queue_bytes = MAX(logstash.pipeline.total.queues.current_size.bytes), max_bytes = MAX(logstash.pipeline.total.queues.max_size.bytes), backpressure = ROUND(MAX(logstash.pipeline.total.flow.queue_backpressure.current), 2), in_eps = ROUND(AVG(logstash.pipeline.total.flow.input_throughput.current)), out_eps = ROUND(AVG(logstash.pipeline.total.flow.output_throughput.current)) BY pipeline, host
| EVAL queue_gb = ROUND(queue_bytes / 1073741824.0, 2), queue_pct = ROUND(100.0 * queue_bytes / max_bytes, 1)
| WHERE queue_bytes > 5368709120 OR queue_pct > 25
| EVAL queue_gb = TO_STRING(queue_gb), queue_pct = TO_STRING(queue_pct), backpressure = TO_STRING(backpressure), in_eps = TO_STRING(in_eps), out_eps = TO_STRING(out_eps)
| KEEP pipeline, host, queue_gb, queue_pct, backpressure, in_eps, out_eps
